'''George Phillips Bevan''' (1829–1889) FSS FGS was a Welsh statistician, geographer and author, and the brother of [[William Latham Bevan]].<ref>{{cite DNB12|wstitle=Bevan, William Latham|volume=1}}</ref>

His father was William Hibbs Bevan (1788–1846), who was high sheriff for Breconshire in 1841, and his brother, [[William Bevan (priest)|William Bevan]], was archdeacon of Brecon from 1875.<ref>{{Who's Who | title=Church Jones, Henry James | id = U195346 | type = was | volume = 1897–1919 | edition = January 2018 online |access-date=13 January 2018}}</ref> His mother Margaret, daughter of Joseph Latham, was also of Beaufort. He was educated at [[Rugby School]], going on to graduate from [[St Andrew's University]] with M.D. in 1850, having also studied at King's College, London, and Edinburgh University.<ref>href=https://arts.st-andrews.ac.uk/biographical-register/data/documents/1366864100 St Andrews Biographical Register</ref> He was Surgeon for the Beaufort Iron Works at the time of the 1851 census. By 1858 he was a Fellow of the [[Geological Society]] and contributed a paper (in two parts) to the journal ''The Geologist''. He was a partner in Bevan & Brewer, Colliery Proprietors until that company was dissolved in 1864.<ref>London Gazette, Feb 5</ref>  By 1871 he had moved to [[Kensington]] and is listed in the census as a ''Scientific author''.

==Bevan's ''Statistical Atlas'' (1882)==
His ''Statistical Atlas'' was a massive tome with 45 plates, each 20×28 inches, and many statistical tables.

It provides a useful reference list of schools of the period.

===''The Educational Condition of the United Kingdom''===
These tables and map provide a useful reference to educational institutions of the 1880s, including statistical information about the following:
* [[Primitive Methodist]]
** ''York Jubilee School'' ([[Elmfield College]])
** ''Birmingham [[Bourne College]]''
* [[Moravian Church|Moravian]]
**[[Fulneck School]]
**[[Gomersal School]]
**[[Mirfield School]]
**[[Wyke School]]

==Publications==
* 1858 ''On the Geology of the Beaufort and Ebbw Vale District of the South Wales Coal-field''. The Geologist 1(2), Feb, pp.&nbsp;49–54;1(4), Apr, pp.&nbsp;124–129
* 1880 ''The strikes of the past ten years''. Journal of the Statistical Society of London, 43(1), 35–64.
*1880 ''Tourists' Guide to the West Riding of Yorkshire ... With ... Maps.''
*1882 ''The Statistical Atlas of England, Scotland and Ireland''. Edinburgh & London: [[W. & A. K. Johnston]]

==''British Manufacturing Industries''==
Bevan edited a series of volumes consisting of papers on primary manufacturing and crafts in the UK. There were 15 volumes, published from 1876 to 1878.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://archive.org/stream/adictionaryecon01wattgoog#page/n20/mode/2up |title=A dictionary of the economic products of India, Volume 1 |date= |access-date=2015-11-18}}</ref>
